Just as the duck-and-cover pamphlets of the 1950s never protected anyone from the atomic bomb, but merely taught us to hold still while it exploded, contemporary discourse around AI oscillates between doomer spectacle, savior hype, and transhumanist fantasy — three ways of narrating a catastrophe long underway, without genuinely confronting it.
